lines.text: F. 16. Περὶ κατακλίσεως· ἐπιτομὴ Παγχαρίου1.
lines.en: F. 16. On decumbiture: epitome of Pancharius1.

lines.text: <Ἐν Κριῷ>· Σελήνη πρὸς Ἄρην ἢ Ἥλιον παροῦσα ἢ τετραγωνί-
lines.en: <In Aries>: Moon present with Mars or Sun or squaring

lines.text: ζουσα ἢ διαμετροῦσα, τοῦ Κρόνου τὸ αὐτὸ σχῆμα ἔχοντος, μάλιστα
lines.en: or opposing, Saturn having the same figure, especially

lines.text: προσθετικὴ τοῖς ἀριθμοῖς ἢ τῷ φωτί, ἀθεώρητος ἀγαθοποιοῦ, μέχρι
lines.en: increasing in numbers or in light, unaspected by a benefic, until

lines.text: τῆς ζʹ ἀναιρεῖ. Σελήνη πρὸς Κρόνον, ἀφαιρετικὴ τῷ φωτὶ μᾶλλον καὶ
lines.en: the 7th (day) destroys. Moon to Saturn, decreasing in light rather and

lines.text: τοῖς ἀριθμοῖς, περὶ τὴν ἐνενηκοστὴν μοῖραν μεγάλας <νόσους> ἐπιση-
lines.en: in numbers, around the ninetieth degree signifies great <diseases>;

lines.text: μαίνει· ἐὰν δὲ καὶ Ἑρμῆς συσχηματισθῇ μόνος τῷ Κρόνῳ πρὸς Σελήνην,
lines.en: and if Mercury also is configured alone with Saturn to the Moon,

lines.text: ἀπαραβάτως ἀναιρεῖ· ὁ δὲ Ἥλιος καὶ ὁ Ἑρμῆς πρὸς τὸ προκείμενον
lines.en: it destroys inevitably; but let the Sun and Mercury to the proposed

lines.text: σχῆμα μᾶλλον ἀντιλήπτορές σοι νοείσθωσαν· ἀλλὰ μὴν καὶ ἀγαθοποιὸς
lines.en: figure be considered by you rather as helpers; but indeed also a benefic

lines.text: ἐὰν ἐπιβῇ, μέχρι τοῦ ἄκρου κινδύνου ἐλεύσεται, ὑπερβὰς δὲ τὴν διάμε-
lines.en: if it supervenes, it will come to the extreme of danger, but having passed the opposi-

lines.text: τρον, σωθήσεται. Σελήνη πρὸς Ἑρμῆν καὶ Ἥλιον, προσθετικὴ τοῖς
lines.en: tion, it will be saved. Moon to Mercury and Sun, increasing in

lines.text: ἀριθμοῖς ἢ καὶ τῷ φωτί, ἐπισφαλῆ καὶ ὀξύτατα πάθη μέχρι τῆς διαμέ-
lines.en: numbers or also in light, will make dangerous and most acute affections until the opposi-

lines.text: τρου ποιήσει· ἐὰν δὲ Ἑρμῆς συσχηματισθῇ, σωθήσεται κινδυνεύσας.
lines.en: tion; but if Mercury is configured, having been in danger it will be saved.

lines.text: Σελήνη πρὸς Ἑρμῆν καὶ πρὸς ἀμφοτέρους καὶ πρὸς ἕνα μόνον τῶν
lines.en: Moon to Mercury and to both and to one only of the

lines.text: ἀγαθοποιῶν, ἀνωμάλως μὲν νόσους καὶ μεταπιπτούσας εἰς ἑτέρας
lines.en: benefics, makes diseases irregularly and changing into others,

lines.text: ποιεῖ, σώζει δὲ ἀπαραβάτως.
lines.en: but saves inevitably.

lines.text: Ἐν Ταύρῳ· Σελήνη πρὸς Κρόνον, μάλιστα τοῖς ἀριθμοῖς καὶ τῷ
lines.en: In Taurus: Moon to Saturn, especially in numbers and in

lines.text: φωτὶ ἀφαιρετική, ἀγαθοποιῶν μὴ ἐπιθεωρούντων, μέχρι τῆς διαμέτρου
lines.en: light decreasing, benefics not aspecting, until the opposition

lines.text: ἀπαραβάτως ἀναιρεῖ. τοῦ δὲ Ἄρεως ἢ καὶ Ἡλίου τὸ αὐτὸ σχῆμα
lines.en: destroys inevitably. But Mars or also Sun having the same figure,

lines.text: ἐχόντων, κατὰ τὴν πρώτην τετράγωνον ἀναιρεῖ, ἀγαθῶν δὲ θεωρούν-
lines.en: destroys at the first square, but benefics aspecting

sections.text:
1[Pancharium Ptolemaei commentarium scripsisse ex Hephaestionis libro II c. 11
usque adhuc inedito nos docuit Kroll (Philologus N. F. XI, 1898, p. 123). Idem adiecit
in cod. Marciano 336, f. 256r, Pancharii excerptum περὶ φλεβοτομίας καὶ καθάρ-
σεως inveniri (de quo argumento conferre licet, Kühn, Galeni opera, t. XIX, p. 519).
His quae in cod. Laurentiano sub eius nomine tradita sunt, similia praebet liber III
Hermetis Trismegisti ad Ammonem περὶ θερμαινόντων (Ideler, Physici minores, I,
p. 391 sqq.) ex quo libri Florentini scripturam interdum corrigere licet. Utrumque
opusculum ex ampliore libro versibus, ut videtur, concepto (p. 119, v. 12, p. 121,
v. 32) contractum esse crediderim. — F. C.]
sections.en:
1[That Pancharius wrote a commentary on Ptolemy Kroll taught us from Hephaestion's book II c. 11
hitherto unpublished (Philologus N. F. XI, 1898, p. 123). The same added
that in cod. Marcianus 336, f. 256r, an excerpt of Pancharius on phlebotomy and purga-
tion is found (on which argument one may compare Kühn, Galeni opera, t. XIX, p. 519).
Similar things to those which are handed down in the Laurentian codex under his name are provided by book III
of Hermes Trismegistus to Ammon on heating things (Ideler, Physici minores, I,
p. 391 sqq.) from which one may sometimes correct the writing of the Florentine book. Both
little works I would believe to have been contracted from a larger book composed in verses, as it seems (p. 119, v. 12, p. 121,
v. 32). — F. C.]

summary.headline: Pancharius on Decumbiture
summary.text: Pancharius’s astrological-medical rules for decumbiture describe how the Moon’s configurations with Mars, the Sun, Saturn, Mercury, and benefics in Aries and Taurus predict severe illness, danger, recovery, or death at squares, oppositions, and specified degrees. A note identifies Pancharius’s commentary on Ptolemy and related excerpts in Hephaestion, the Marcianus codex, and Hermes Trismegistus.
